sections.voiceover: Washington University is launching a hiring spree for AI philosophers.
Washington University in St. This follows a 2013 report where only 1% of job roles on the academic platform PhilJobs were focused on AI philosophy.
While WashU's initiative is part of a growing trend, Inside Higher Ed reports universities are experiencing an even more significant demand for AI philosophy professors.
This hiring spree underscores the growing importance of AI ethics and knowledge in academia.
Washington University is part of this trend, hiring for the future of AI and philosophy.
